items.title: Police investigate arson on Victorian defence company as 'far left terror'
items.description: It is the first time Australian authorities have investigated what they consider to be a potential far-left terror attack, motivated by anarchist and revolutionary ideology.

items.title: Labor unveils 'widow tax' fix after negative gearing backlash
items.description: The government is also consulting on carve-outs and changes covering newly built homes, affordable and disability housing and its new capital gains tax system.

items.title: Tony Burke delays speech expected to reveal sweeping migration cuts
items.description: The ABC understands the cuts to migration numbers are contentious within Labor, but no reason for the delay is given.

items.title: 'Script hasn't changed': Kevin Rudd derides Hanson's leadership capability
items.description: Former prime minister Kevin Rudd says One Nation leader Pauline Hanson has no real answers for the issues facing Australians but he does believe AUKUS submarines are a good thing for the nation.

items.title: Sportsbet, TAB deny allegations reps offered escort and drugs to gambler
items.description: Sportsbet and TAB have denied explosive claims they offered a young gambler access to illicit drugs and escorts as part of an inducement program.

items.title: US vow to dismantle the International Criminal Court labelled 'very worrying'
items.description: The Trump administration has vowed to dismantle the International Criminal Court "brick by brick", but analysts warn it's a move that has more to do with local politics than genuine concerns about the system.

items.title: 'Our only option': Aboriginal police officers take racism allegations to court
items.description: Current and former Aboriginal community police officers have launched a class action alleging they were racially vilified, abused and underpaid while working for the NT Police Force.

items.title: Solar costs for business to be slashed under energy scheme expansion
items.description: The federal government is set to announce changes to the Small-scale Renewable Energy scheme in a bid to help businesses install solar systems and close the gap with residential take-up.

items.title: Billion-dollar property collapse highlights private credit danger
items.description: Examinations of the downfall of Jon Adgemis's property empire may well shed light on the extent to which private credit firms, essentially a shadow banking industry with little or no regulation, have their hooks into the economy.

items.title: Questions about Sydney protest spark tense exchange at royal commission
items.description: The head of a peak Jewish body has criticised the conduct of protesters at a pro-Palestinian rally in the wake of Hamas's attack on Israel, prompting a tense exchange at the antisemitism royal commission.

items.title: Alan Jones told 17yo 'there are no rules' at his home, court hears
items.description: A man accusing Alan Jones of indecently assaulting him has detailed in court a night at the broadcaster's farm, where he said Mr Jones demanded he have a shower and come out wearing "a robe and nothing else".

items.title: Charity cyclist dies one day after completing 5,300km ride
items.description: Motor neurone disease advocate Bob Montgomery dies just one day after completing a 5,300-kilometre bicycle ride across Australia.

items.title: More than 150 migrants saved from burning boat in English Channel
items.description: French coastguard officials have rescued migrants stranded on a burning boat in the English Channel.

items.title: Five dead in Moscow region as Kyiv targets more Wildberries sites
items.description: Ukraine also targets another warehouse belonging to Russian e-commerce giant Wildberries as both sides trade strikes.

items.title: Solo parenting wasn't for me, so I'm co-parenting with my sister
items.description: Solo parenting, it turns out, wasn't for me. But that's when my sister and I decided to embark on the adventure together.

items.title: Household spending increases in June, powered by EV sales
items.description: Australian household spending rose for a second month in June as consumers splashed out on electric vehicles amid rising fuel costs.

items.title: Kath Pettingill, mother of accused Walsh Street police killers, dies
items.description: Kath Pettingill was the matriarch of the accused Melbourne crime family that was fictionalised in the 2010 movie Animal Kingdom.

items.title: Sydney man charged over fake gun had been at costume party, court told
items.description: A man arrested for carrying a fake gun and wearing a fake police vest at Sydney's Moore Park has been released on bail after a court heard he was attending a costume party.

items.title: Bystanders deprived Canberra man of 'any chance of survival' after overdose
items.description: A coroner finds a group of bystanders, including two workers from a drug harm minimisation organisation, acted in a "morally blameworthy" manner after waiting hours to call an ambulance for a Canberra man who fatally overdosed.

items.title: Teen who stabbed man with brain injury pleads guilty to murder
items.description: A 16-year-old boy has pleaded guilty to the stabbing murder of 25-year-old Jack Westren at Shellharbour Junction train station after a group of minors lured him there via social media.

items.title: Tom Holland and Zendaya become most bankable box office couple in Hollywood
items.description: Real-life Hollywood couple Tom Holland and Zendaya are celebrating simultaneous box office success stories in Spider-Man: Brand New Day and The Odyssey – smash hit movies they both star in.

items.title: From Teardrop to Singapore ban, a guide to Massive Attack
items.description: Massive Attack have landed in Australia for a run of sold-out arena shows this week. If you're wondering what makes them such a big deal, here's your crash course.

items.title: Older people open to downsizing but facing barriers
items.description: Research shows more than half of people over the age of 55 are open to downsizing. But experts say there are barriers stopping older people moving into smaller homes.

items.title: Inside 'Kraken's' sting that led to Sydney underworld figure's arrest
items.description: Sam Amine is awaiting sentence in the NSW District Court after pleading guilty to brokering the supply of the drugs and firearm.

items.title: Minns government rejects hate speech advice it fought to keep secret
items.description: The Minns government has rejected key advice from a review it commissioned, which recommends hate speech laws be extended to protect more members of the community.
